name: node
description: Node.js JavaScript runtime with npm package manager and modern ECMAScript support

node.description: Node.js JavaScript runtime engine for server-side and command-line applications
node.usage:
node app.js # Run JavaScript application
node -e "console.log('Hello World')" # Execute inline JavaScript
node --version # Show Node.js version
node --help # Display help information
node --inspect app.js # Start with debugging enabled
node --experimental-modules app.mjs # Run ES modules

npm.description: Node Package Manager for installing and managing JavaScript packages
npm.usage:
npm install express # Install package locally
npm install -g typescript # Install package globally
npm init -y # Initialize new package.json
npm run build # Run script from package.json
npm list # Show installed packages
npm update # Update all packages

npx.description: Node Package eXecute - run packages without installing them globally
npx.usage:
npx create-react-app my-app # Create React application
npx typescript --version # Run TypeScript compiler
npx eslint . # Run ESLint on current directory
npx prettier --write . # Format code with Prettier
npx --package=cowsay cowsay hello # Run package temporarily

corepack.description: Package manager manager - enables use of Yarn and pnpm without installation
corepack.usage:
corepack enable # Enable corepack for yarn/pnpm
corepack prepare pnpm@latest --activate # Install and activate pnpm
corepack prepare yarn@stable --activate # Install and activate yarn
corepack --version # Show corepack version
